pages.title: Accumulate
pages.text: §lMax Level: §r III$(br2)§lApplicable Items: §r Swords, Axes, Tridents$(br2)§lEffect: §r Hold right-click to charge; each stage takes 5 seconds. After a full charge, the next attack deals stage-multiplied damage with knockback. Switching weapons, taking damage, or going 10 seconds without attacking interrupts the charge.$(br2)§lAcquisition: §r Enchanting Table, Loot Chests, Villager Trades$(br2)§lConflicts: §r Mutually exclusive with other melee damage/growth-type enchantments; only one may be applied to a weapon.
